checks.audit_identity: attempt recorded under credential principal, not caller-supplied agent label
checks.credential_revocation: active Session rejected immediately after revoke
checks.key_rotation: old active Session rejected after agent registration key changed; newly issued credential works
checks.retry: failed first attempt required retry; retry rechecked identity and refused before second callback

limitations: The retry test uses an in-memory service. Cross-process durable revocation depends on the configured revocation backend; persistent deployments use SQLite-backed revocations.
